theme: The last dry-land day before Croatia.
greeting: A quiet Labor Day in St. Pete with the girls, Dan, and the final runway before tomorrow evening's flight to Frankfurt. Nothing sits on the calendar today, so the open hours stand against a trip list that wants closing before you board.

needsAttention.title: The Sept 20-Oct 5 car hedge comes due
needsAttention.detail: Your own note set today as the decision point: keep the refundable Full-Size SUV booked for the return, or cancel it if Mike's car is confirmed heading south. It sits p2 on the Mike + Dan board.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags, and two 55L duffels will not pass as carry-on. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags online before the airport counter tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: The Sept 19 Cavtat room is still open
needsAttention.detail: The night after the charter has to be booked from dry land while there is signal. Cavtat, near the airport and refundable, sets up the 5 AM Sunday departure.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Confirm Saturday's boarding time and place and arrange the return transfer to Dubrovnik airport now, before connectivity drops for the week aboard.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Oct 31 falls inside the girls' residence block, and the Oct 18 St. Pete Airbnb and car both book while you are away. The call is cleaner made tonight than from a boat.

flagged.title: Croatia check-in is open
flagged.detail: Discover Airlines opened online check-in for tomorrow's Tampa-Dubrovnik flight, and Kayak sent the Frankfurt boarding pass.

flagged.title: A caregiver applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Alexa B. applied to your posting; a look worth saving for after the trip.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day sale blasts, receipts, and a campaign fundraising ask.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: Pre-Croatia errands cleared
resolved.detail: Ten items ticked off today: groceries, the travel iron, Claire's shoes, Mike's J.Crew, packing supplies. The shopping list is done.

recipe.title: Quinces Poached in Muscat
recipe.why: Quince arrives with autumn — a slow poach turns it fragrant and rose-gold.

tasks.title: Book the St. Pete nights Sept 20-22 (landing gap)
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: Labor Day opened with nothing on the calendar, the whole morning free for packing and errands.
Still no meetings; the St. Pete rental runs through the 9th, so the middle of the day stayed loose.
Tomorrow's 5:55 PM flight to Frankfurt is the pivot, and tonight is the last evening on dry land before twelve days at sea.
